identity.title: CVE-2026-84452
identity.description: Windows ML CLI is a command line tool for building portable, performant, and high-quality AI models for Windows ML. Prior to 0.4.0, the src/winml/modelkit/serve/cli_api.py component exposes WinML CLI commands through a localhost HTTP API without authentication and configures the allow_origins setting as a wildcard in both src/winml/modelkit/serve/cli_api.py and src/winml/modelkit/serve/app.py. A malicious website loaded by a user can send cross-origin requests to /v1/cli/build or /v1/cli/config and set the trust_remote_code parameter to true, which is converted to the --trust-remote-code command-line flag without validation. This reaches AutoConfig.from_pretrained with trust_remote_code=True in src/winml/modelkit/loader/_autoconfig.py and imports Python code from an attacker-controlled model repository, resulting in arbitrary code execution as the server user. This issue is fixed in version 0.4.0.

cwe_names.CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Security Policy with Untrusted Domains

_relevance.reason: Local developer CLI tool with browser-based exploitation path and no core DPI or enterprise infrastructure footprint.

identity.title: CVE-2026-53649
identity.description: Joro is a web exploitation framework. Prior to version 1.1.1, Joro's default proxy mode exposes a local API on 127.0.0.1:9090 that performs no authentication and applies a wildcard CORS policy. Because plugin uploads use the CORS-safelisted multipart/form-data content type, cross-origin JavaScript on any page the operator visits can reach privileged endpoints - including uploading a native plugin and triggering a restart - directly through the operator's browser, with no preflight or credentials. Since plugins execute on load, this yields unauthenticated remote code execution as the operator's user from a single page visit. This issue has been patched in version 1.1.1.

cwe_names.CWE-434: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
cwe_names.CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Security Policy with Untrusted Domains

_relevance.reason: Drone/robotics autopilot firmware with no enterprise or DPI footprint, requiring specific command invocation with no exploitation signal.

identity.title: CVE-2026-84696
identity.description: Phison PS3111-S11 controller firmware versions through SBFQT1.3 expose privileged vendor unique commands over the ATA interface with absent or defeatable authentication mechanisms. Attackers can bypass the weak CRC-16 based unlock handshake or exploit builds with no VUC lock to read and write controller memory and raw flash, persisting implants across power cycles.

_relevance.reason: SSD controller firmware requiring physical/local ATA access with no enterprise DPI nexus or exploitation signal.

identity.title: CVE-2024-35585
identity.description: Oxford Nanopore MinKNOW before 24.06 relies on a client's source IP address for authentication.

_relevance.reason: Specialized DNA sequencing instrument software with weak IP-based authentication, no enterprise DPI footprint or exploitation signal.

identity.title: CVE-2025-46418
identity.description: Westermo WeOS 5.x starting from 5.24 allows OS command injection via a media definition.
